Every network message (RPC) of game build 25480438, as its network configuration declares it, for `rpc_listen` and
`rpc_send` ([networking](modding/networking.md)). Each one's `HF_RPC_<NAME>`, `HfRpc_<name>`, `hf_rpc_<name>_read` and
`hf_rpc_<name>_send` are in `native/mod-sdk/hellforge_rpcs.h`. Arguments are named after their network type where
that name is known, else `arg<n>`. Session-bound RPCs only travel inside a game session.
